[EN] Feed Them for Our Survival
[ES] Aliméntalas para nuestra supervivencia
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Every little bit helps.
[ES] Cada pequeño aporte cuenta.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I thank you. The cows thank you.
[ES] Te lo agradezco. Las vacas te lo agradecen.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "For the federation!"
[ES] "¡Por la federación!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Collect sweet hayblossoms that grow near the ranch to feed the Two Oaks Ranch cows.
[ES] Recoge flores de heno dulce que crecen cerca del rancho para alimentar a las vacas de Two Oaks Ranch.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver sweet hayblossoms to the rancher's wife, Fanella, at Two Oaks Ranch.
[ES] Llévale las flores de heno dulce a la esposa del ranchero, Fanella, en Two Oaks Ranch.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
